title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
slides: Unlimited GPT-4o chats, free—what's the catch?
It replaces the old daily message limits
But unlimited doesn't mean unlimited AI power
Expect slower responses under peak load
Test your prompts now; compare speed today
thread_text:
1. What's the real catch?

OpenAI removed daily caps, but unlimited access hides a slower experience. You get more chats, yet response speed may drop sharply during peak hours.

2. The old limits are gone

Previously, free users hit a message ceiling. Now that barrier vanishes, shifting the bottleneck from count to speed.

3. Speed is the new limit

During busy times, expect delays. The service prioritizes paying customers, so free chats queue behind them.

4. Unmetered, not unrestrained

Unlimited doesn't mean infinite compute. It's a trade-off: breadth over immediacy.

5. Test your prompts now

Run a quick query today and measure response latency. If you're not getting fast replies, is the trade-off worth it?

instagram.caption:
Free users just got unlimited ChatGPT chats—but the old daily message cap is simply being swapped for slower replies during peak hours.  

OpenAI removed the message ceiling for GPT-4o, yet paying customers still jump the queue. When traffic spikes, your prompts wait in line, and speed becomes the new barrier.  

For content creators running brainstorming or drafting sessions, this means you can keep typing all day—but your flow will stall exactly when you need quick outputs.  

Run one test prompt at 9 AM and one at 3 PM today. If the latency gap bothers you, is free access still worth it? ⏱️🔄
